(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A method for selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising: receiving a request from the client computer; accessing a first server computer and a second server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

(Currently Amended) Claim 24: A system for selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising: a first server computer; a second server computer; a path in a computer network including one or more server computers; circuitry for accessing the first server computer and the second server computer through the path; circuitry for adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and circuitry for selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

(Currently Amended) Claim 27: A computer program product for selecting an edge server computer for sending data to a client computer, the computer program product comprising: a computer-readable medium having program code thereon for causing a computer to perform the steps of receiving a request from the client computer; accessing a first server computer and a second server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer; the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.
